description: A POINTER, never a copy. One row per thing that happened on a lead — a call, a note, a task, a file, a comment, an email — holding only which record it was and when. The Activity rail reads this ONE indexed table instead of merging six source tables at read time, so a page costs one seek whatever the lead's age, and a new event type is a hook rather than a new query leg. Nothing here is a source of truth: every field is derivable from the source row, the card's content is hydrated from that row at read time, and the table can be rebuilt from source at any moment. Written only by tatva_connect.activity.timeline.

fields.label: Reference Doctype
fields.description: The record the rail belongs to — CRM Lead today, CRM Deal when deals get the same rail.

fields.label: Reference Name
fields.description: The lead this event happened on. Not a Link: the target doctype varies, exactly as frappe's own Version and Comment do it.

fields.label: Event On
fields.description: When it happened — the source row's creation. The ONE column the rail sorts by, which is what lets every type share a single order.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: call / note / task / file / comment / email. What the rail renders it as.

fields.label: Source Doctype
fields.description: Where the real row lives. The rail hydrates the card from it, so this table never holds content that could go stale.

fields.label: Source Name
fields.description: Which row. Unique with source_doctype, which is what makes the backfill re-runnable and a double-fired hook a no-op.

name: CRM Timeline Event
